rules.bin: Yellow bin (Wertstofftonne), blue paper bin (Papiertonne) or glass container, depending on the material
rules.reason: Plastic, metal and drink-carton packaging, and small plastic or metal household items, go in the yellow bin. Paper and cardboard go in the blue paper bin or a paper depot container. Glass bottles and jars go in the glass containers, sorted by colour.
Food leftovers, fruit and vegetable scraps, coffee grounds, tea bags, eggshells, lawn clippings and leaves go in the brown bin. No plastic bags, not even bags sold as compostable.
Everything that fits no other bin goes here, for example crockery, wallpaper scraps, renovation leftovers, diapers, hygiene items, plasters and cat litter.
